message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/json_prettify.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"beautiful","code":"[[maybe_unused]] auto beautiful = glz::prettify_json(input);","note":"The fuzzer feeds attacker-controlled bytes into the JSON prettifier, which parses and rewrites the input into a new buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"include/glaze/json/prettify.hpp","function":"detail::prettify_json","line":18,"var":"*it","code":"switch (json_types[uint8_t(*it)]) {","note":"The prettifier classifies each byte and dispatches on JSON token type while walking the input stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"include/glaze/util/dump.hpp","function":"dump_not_empty","line":171,"var":"b[ix]","code":"std::memcpy(&b[ix], str.data(), n);","note":"Token text is copied into the output buffer with raw memcpy, so the write index must remain in bounds."},
  {"step":4,"file":"include/glaze/json/prettify.hpp","function":"detail::prettify_json","line":205,"var":"out","code":"out.resize(ix);","note":"After rewriting, the output vector is truncated to the number of bytes emitted; any write-index miscalculation would surface as a container overflow in the preceding memcpy sink."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze/fuzzing/json_prettify.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json
